Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
K9 Ballistics • AI Assistant
Yes — you can request a cancellation after placing an order, but there is not a guaranteed cancellation window. K9 Ballistics says orders are processed very quickly, so the sooner you contact them, the better the chance they can catch it before it is packed or shipped.
What the policy says:
- If the order has already been packed and shipped, it cannot be canceled.
- If you have already received a tracking number, it cannot be canceled.
- If the order includes personalization, it cannot be canceled.
- K9 Ballistics cannot guarantee that a cancellation request will succeed.
To request cancellation:
- Call 844-772-3125 as soon as possible.
- Business hours are Monday through Friday, 5 AM to 4 PM Pacific.
- If it is after business hours, email info@k9ballistics.com with "Please Cancel Order" followed by your order number in the subject line.
- Do not reply to order confirmation or other automated emails with the request.
